description: This source file defines a MedicalAgent class that performs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a vector store of guidelines to produce medical recommendations and suggests medicines based on user queries. It includes methods for fetching relevant guidelines and adding heuristic medicine suggestions, always with a disclaimer.
